description: Test cases for SAP Discovery pipeline skill — landscape assessment, scope, module selection, readiness, migration path decision.

evals.name: greenfield-new-entity
evals.prompt: Discovery SAP S/4HANA Cloud para AcmeCorp, nuevo holding retail, 3 países LatAm, 200 usuarios, sin ERP previo. ¿Qué pipeline ejecuto?
evals.expected_output: Full discovery plan with CP-0..CP-8 phases, recommends Greenfield, high readiness score
assertions: All 8 landscape dimensions addressed (some as [SUPUESTO] if no data)
Module selection decision tree for retail

evals.name: brownfield-ecc-migration
evals.prompt: Discovery para BetaCorp — ECC 6.0 EhP7 actual, 500 Z-objects, 8 países, 2000 usuarios. Evaluar migración a S/4HANA.
evals.expected_output: Landscape with Clean Core readiness, custom code analysis, likely Brownfield or Bluefield recommendation
assertions: Clean Core readiness evaluated (Z-objects > 500 is high debt)
Migration path scoring applied (tech debt + transformation ambition + data complexity)
Phase Zero governance mandatory before Discover

evals.name: incomplete-context-handling
evals.prompt: Haz discovery SAP para mi empresa.
evals.expected_output: Skill identifies [VACIO_CRITICO], asks clarifying questions (industry, countries, user count, current ERP)
assertions: Lists minimum info required to start discovery

evals.name: low-readiness-warning
evals.prompt: Cliente quiere hacer SAP, pero CEO no está engaged, procesos no documentados, data quality mala. ¿Procedo?
evals.expected_output: Readiness score < 2.5, HIGH RISK banner, recommend defer or descope
assertions: Readiness score calculated and shown as < 2.5
Recommendation: defer or focus on Phase Zero first
